files.name: logo-antique-v1.png
files.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset: transparent raster title logo for a 2D pixel-art noir casino heist game. Create one wide isolated typographic logo on genuinely transparent background. Exact text on two lines: 'CARD' above 'TWO SIGHT'. Very readable engraved antique gold serif letters, Victorian casino sign, elegant old-world sharp serifs, subtle brass bevel and worn scratched gold leaf, restrained baroque gold flourishes and tiny diamond-shaped separators. Dark dried crimson blood stains at a few letter edges and small scattered flecks, NEVER obscuring letter readability. No people, no injuries. Warm gold and aged brass, sparse dark oxblood accents, crisp detailed game-asset pixel painting compatible with burgundy curtains and green felt casino. Wide composition ~3:1, title occupies most of canvas with small transparent safe margins, centered and balanced. No background panel, no scene, no shadow rectangle, no extra words, no watermark. Spell CARD TWO SIGHT exactly.

files.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE blank premium game menu button, horizontal very wide aspect 5:1, front-facing flat UI orthographic, isolated with genuinely transparent outside corners. A continuous intact rectangular dark burgundy leather inset, wide empty clean center suitable for Korean UI text to be overlaid by game code. Antique engraved brass/gold double border, restrained Victorian baroque CORNER engravings, beveled metal edging, subtle worn gold, small brass rivets at far ends. No glow outside, no watermark.

One decal only, no sheet or multiple holes. No watermark.
